name: Hywel Dda UHB — Adult ADHD Service
description: Local NHS Wales adult ADHD service information describing professional referral for diagnostic assessment and treatment in Carmarthenshire, Ceredigion and Pembrokeshire.
intended_use: Inspect one current Welsh health-board adult ADHD pathway without turning it into a national Wales referral rule.
audience_or_context: Adults in the Hywel Dda University Health Board area who are considering ADHD assessment, and professionals or supporters helping them navigate the service.
limitations: This is a Hywel Dda University Health Board pathway, not a Wales-wide adult ADHD referral rule.
Current eligibility, referral rules and capacity can change.
Diagnosis, treatment, prescribing and shared-care decisions are distinct and are not collapsed into one entitlement by this listing.
cost_or_access_notes: NHS access depends on current local catchment and eligibility.
conflicts_of_interest: Hywel Dda University Health Board describes a service it provides; ND Oracle records the local route without assuming national availability or individual outcome.

provenance.method: Current Hywel Dda Adult ADHD Service page checked on 2026-09-03 for age/catchment and professional-referral wording. Listing is local, descriptive and claimless.
